verses.zh: 來 罷 ， 我 們 歸 向 耶 和 華 ！ 他 撕 裂 我 們 ， 也 必 醫 治 ； 他 打 傷 我 們 ， 也 必 纏 裹 。
verses.en: Come on! Let’s return to the Lord.He himself has torn us to pieces, but he will heal us!He has injured[NOTE:1] us, but he will bandage our wounds!
notes: “has struck”; cf. NRSV “struck down.”

verses.zh: 過 兩 天 他 必 使 我 們 甦 醒 ， 第 三 天 他 必 使 我 們 興 起 ， 我 們 就 在 他 面 前 得 以 存 活 。
verses.en: He will restore[NOTE:1] us in a very short time;[NOTE:2] he will heal us in a little while,[NOTE:3] so that we may live in his presence.
notes: “has struck”; cf. NRSV “struck down.”

The Piel of חָיָה (khayah) may mean: (1) to keep/preserve persons alive from the threat of premature death (1 Kgs 20:31; Ezek 13:18; 18:27); (2) to restore the dead to physical life (Deut 32:39; 1 Sam 2:6; cf. NCV “will put new life in us”); or (3) to restore the dying back to life from the threat of death (Ps 71:20; BDB 311 s.v. חָיָה).
Heb “after two days” (so KJV, NIV, NRSV). The expression “after two days” is an idiom meaning “after a short time” (see, e.g., Judg 11:4; BDB 399 s.v. יוֹם 5.a).

verses.zh: 我 們 務 要 認 識 耶 和 華 ， 竭 力 追 求 認 識 他 。 他 出 現 確 如 晨 光 ， 他 必 臨 到 我 們 像 甘 雨 ， 像 滋 潤 田 地 的 春 雨 。
verses.en: So let us search for him![NOTE:1] Let us seek[NOTE:2] to know the Lord!He will come to our rescue as certainly as the appearance of the dawn,as certainly as the winter rain comes,as certainly as the spring rain that waters the land.

verses.zh: 主 說 ： 以 法 蓮 哪 ， 我 可 向 你 怎 樣 行 呢 ？ 猶 大 啊 ， 我 可 向 你 怎 樣 做 呢 ？ 因 為 你 們 的 良 善 如 同 早 晨 的 雲 霧 ， 又 如 速 散 的 甘 露 。
verses.en: What am I going to do with you, O Ephraim?What am I going to do with you, O Judah?For[NOTE:1] your faithfulness is as fleeting as the morning mist;[NOTE:2] it disappears as quickly as dawn’s dew.[NOTE:3]
notes: “has struck”; cf. NRSV “struck down.”

verses.zh: 因 此 ， 我 藉 先 知 砍 伐 他 們 ， 以 我 口 中 的 話 殺 戮 他 們 ； 我 施 行 的 審 判 如 光 發 出 。
verses.en: Therefore, I will certainly cut[NOTE:1] you into pieces at the hands of the prophets;[NOTE:2] I will certainly kill you[NOTE:3] in fulfillment of my oracles of judgment,[NOTE:4] for[NOTE:5] my judgment[NOTE:6] will come forth like the light of the dawn.[NOTE:7]
notes: “has struck”; cf. NRSV “struck down.”

NCV “will put new life in us”); or (3) to restore the dying back to life from the threat of death (Ps 71:20; BDB 311 s.v. חָיָה).
Heb “after two days” (so KJV, NIV, NRSV). The expression “after two days” is an idiom meaning “after a short time” (see, e.g., Judg 11:4; BDB 399 s.v. יוֹם 5.a).

Heb “on the third day” (so NASB, NIV, NRSV), which parallels “after two days” and means “in a little while.” The “2-3” sequence is an example of graded numerical parallelism (Prov 30:15-16, 18-19, 21-23, 24-28, 29-31). This expresses the unrepentant overconfidence of Israel that the Lord’s discipline of Israel would be relatively short and that he would restore them quickly.

Lexical and syntactical questions create three possibilities for understanding this verb. The verb form וְנֵדְעָה (venedeʿah) is a vav plus first plural cohortative either from יָדַע (yadaʿ, “to know”) or דָּעָה (daʿah, “to seek”). If from יָדַע (yadaʿ), it could be finishing v. 2: “so that we may live before him and know him.” The object (“him”) is understood from the previous clause, or perhaps the object may be added to the verb by emending it to וְנֵדָעֵהוּ (venedaʿehu). Most translations treat it as beginning v. 3 and from יָדַע (yadaʿ), either “Let us know” (e.g. NASB, ESV, NKJV, NRSV) or “Let us acknowledge” (e.g. NIV). Several dictionaries (HALOT 228, NIDOTTE 959, and Concise DCH 81) treat it as from דָּעָה (daʿah). The idea of seeking or requesting fits well with the following verb, רָדַף (radaf, “to pursue”).

Heb “let us pursue in order to know.” The Hebrew term רָדַף (radaf, “to pursue”) is used figuratively: “to aim to secure” (BDB 923 s.v. רָדַף 2). It describes the pursuit of a moral goal: “Do not pervert justice…nor accept a bribe…pursue [רָדַף] justice” (Deut 16:20); “those who pursue [רָדַף] righteousness and who seek [בָּקַשׁ, baqash] the Lord” (Isa 51:1); “He who pursues [רָדַף] righteousness and love finds life, prosperity, and honor” (Prov 21:20); “Seek [בָּקַשׁ] peace and pursue [רָדַף] it” (Ps 34:15); and “they slander me when I pursue [רָדַף] good” (Ps 38:21).
The vav prefixed to וְחַסְדְּכֶם (vekhasdekhem, “your faithfulness”) functions in an explanatory sense (“For”).

verses.en: At Adam[NOTE:1] they broke[NOTE:2] the covenant;Oh how[NOTE:3] they were unfaithful[NOTE:4] to me!

verses.en: Gilead is a city full of evildoers;[NOTE:1] its streets are stained with bloody footprints![NOTE:2]

verses.zh: 強 盜 成 群 ， 怎 樣 埋 伏 殺 人 ， 祭 司 結 黨 ， 也 照 樣 在 示 劍 的 路 上 殺 戮 ， 行 了 邪 惡 。
verses.en: The company of priests is like a gang of robbers,lying in ambush to pounce on a victim.They commit murder on the road to Shechem;they have done heinous crimes!

verses.zh: 在 以 色 列 家 ， 我 見 了 可 憎 的 事 ； 在 以 法 蓮 那 裡 有 淫 行 ， 以 色 列 被 玷 污 。
verses.en: I have seen a disgusting thing in the house of Israel:There Ephraim commits prostitution with other gods,[NOTE:1]and Israel defiles itself.
notes: “has struck”; cf. NRSV “struck down.”

verses.zh: 猶 大 啊 ， 我 使 被 擄 之 民 歸 回 的 時 候 ， 必 有 為 你 所 命 定 的 收 場 。
verses.en: I have appointed a time to reap judgment[NOTE:1] for you also, O Judah!Whenever I want to restore the fortunes of my people,[NOTE:2]
